title: High Priest
summary: The high priest held the leading priestly role and entered the Most Holy Place on the Day of Atonement.
background: The high priest represented the people in the most solemn priestly service. Hebrews uses this background to proclaim Jesus as the perfect and final High Priest.
teachingHelp: High-priest passages should be taught as both historical priesthood and a major bridge to Christ’s finished mediation.
sources: James M. Freeman, Hand-book of Bible Manners and Customs (public-domain editions).
Alfred Edersheim, Sketches of Jewish Social Life in the Days of Christ (1876).
Alfred Edersheim, The Temple: Its Ministry and Services as They Were at the Time of Jesus Christ (1881).
